transaction_extraction.task: Extract transaction data from China Merchants Bank transaction statement

column_descriptions.debit: 借方(出账) - Outgoing amount. May be EMPTY if transaction is incoming. Located BEFORE credit column.
column_descriptions.credit: 贷方(入账) - Incoming amount. May be EMPTY if transaction is outgoing. Located BETWEEN debit and balance.
column_descriptions.balance: 余额 - Account balance AFTER this transaction. ALWAYS has a value, NEVER empty. Located AFTER credit column. This is the RIGHTMOST of the 3 amount columns.
column_descriptions.card_number: 公司一卡通号 - Company card number. Usually EMPTY or contains short code. Located BEFORE print_instance_id.
column_descriptions.print_instance_id: 打印实例号 - Print instance ID. Contains long alphanumeric code like '536B10xxxxx'. This is the RIGHTMOST column in the entire table.

details: These are 3 consecutive amount columns from left to right: Debit → Credit → Balance
Balance (余额, column 5) ALWAYS has a value - it shows account balance after transaction
Debit (借方, column 3) and Credit (贷方, column 4) are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE - only ONE has value, the other MUST be empty string
COMMON ERROR: When only 2 values appear (e.g., outgoing transaction), the rightmost value is Balance, NOT Credit
These are the last 2 columns at the RIGHT edge of the table
card_number (公司一卡通号, column 10) - Usually EMPTY or contains very short value. Located BEFORE print_instance_id.
print_instance_id (打印实例号, column 11) - Contains long alphanumeric codes like '536B10436199', '536B20349777'. This is the RIGHTMOST column.
Each valid record MUST contain a date in yyyy-MM-dd format in 'transaction_date' field
Blacklist keywords: if content contains '.com', 'http', 'Enquiry', 'aspx', discard the entire row

extraction_rules.rule: Column boundary detection using black guide lines (L1-L10)
details: Left of L1: transaction_id
Between L1-L2: transaction_date (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, merge multi-line)
Between L2-L3: debit (借方/出账) - may be EMPTY
Between L3-L4: credit (贷方/入账) - may be EMPTY, do NOT grab balance from right
Between L4-L5: balance (余额) - ALWAYS has a value, never empty
Between L5-L6: payee_name (merge multi-line)
Between L6-L7: payee_account
Between L7-L8: memo
Between L8-L9: transaction_type
Between L9-L10: card_number (公司一卡通号) - Usually EMPTY, do NOT grab print_instance_id from right
Right of L10: print_instance_id (打印实例号) - Long codes like 536Bxxxxxxxx

noise_filters: URL noise: Force ignore URL strings at top and bottom of page
Footer noise: Never extract page numbers, tips, etc.
merge_rules: payee_name, transaction_id, print_instance_id spanning multiple lines must be merged vertically
stop_conditions: Stop when table end line is detected or invalid row content is encountered
output_constraints: What you see is what you get - ensure data completeness
Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

summary_extraction.task: Extract summary information from China Merchants Bank statement first page header area
extraction_rules: Only extract from text description area at top of first page
Do NOT extract from transaction detail table below
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values
